title: Queued proposals can price the guardian out of pausing
rootCause: Timelock.pause cancels every live proposal in one loop, so whoever holds the signer keys can schedule enough of them that a pause costs more gas than a block holds, and the guardian cannot stop what was queued.

poc.observable: test_the_guardian_can_still_pause_inside_one_block fails with "gas for the pause by the guardian: 44441215 >= 30000000"
